components.name: Button
components.description: The one button vocabulary: square, ruled, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.125rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-ink, #141414); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #141414); font: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #141414); color: var(--color-paper, #fff); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink, #141414); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Plate
components.description: The inverted opaque band for the one main action, shown once a cell is selected.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem; background: #141414; color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #141414; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-plate p { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-plate span { margin-left: 0.5rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-plate-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-plate-btn, .ds-plate-main { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.125rem; border: 1.5px solid #fff; border-radius: 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-plate-btn { background: transparent; color: #fff; } .ds-plate-btn:hover { background: #fff; color: #141414; } .ds-plate-main { background: #fff; color: #141414; } .ds-plate-main:hover { background: #d90018; border-color: #d90018; color: #fff; } .ds-plate button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square ruled input, ink border on focus, red border when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1.5px solid #80858c; border-radius: 0; background: #fff; color: #141414; font: inherit; caret-color: #d90018; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #141414; outline-offset: 0; border-color: #141414; } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #d90018; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Top rule: 6px ink band, product name, text links with a 3px active underline.

components.name: Grid Cell
components.description: A ruled timetable cell: a fixed-position mark above a state word. Shown here: libre, ocupada, tuya, seleccionada.
components.html:
Libre
Ocupada

components.css: .ds-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 5.75rem); border: 1.5px solid #141414; } .ds-cell { box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 3.875rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.375rem 0.375rem 0.5rem; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #c9ccd1; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9ccd1; font-size: 0.75rem; font-stretch: 90%; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cell:hover { background: #f3f4f5; } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #141414; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-mark { box-sizing: border-box; width: 0.8125rem; height: 0.8125rem; border: 1.5px solid #141414; background: #fff; } .ds-ocupada { background: #f3f4f5; } .ds-ocupada .ds-mark { background: #141414; } .ds-tuya { background: #fdecee; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tuya .ds-mark { background: #d90018; border-color: #d90018; } .ds-sel { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #d90018; font-weight: 700; } .ds-sel .ds-mark { border: 3px solid #d90018; }

components.name: Grid Head
components.description: Sticky hours row: large hour, quiet minutes, wash fill, heavy ink underline.
components.css: .ds-head { box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; width: 5.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.5rem 0.375rem; background: #f3f4f5; border-right: 1px solid #c9ccd1; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #141414; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-head span { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 400; color: #55595f; }

narrative.overview:
A day of courts is read as one printed timetable page, in the manner of a Swiss or European railway Fahrplan: strict rows and columns, hairline rules, data and nothing else. White offset-printed stock, near-black ink, grey hairlines and a single signal red. The system refuses the sporty rounded-card booking app and the dashboard of cards; there are no cards here, only ruled boxes.

Everything is square. Depth does not exist: rules, weight, and inversion do the work that shadows and fills do elsewhere. State is never carried by colour alone: every grid cell holds a word plus a mark in a fixed place, and colour only reinforces. Figures and hours are tabular so columns read as columns.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral grotesque (Archivo Variable) in few sizes, hours and figures tabular.
Hairline-square corners everywhere; no radii, no gradients, no drop shadows.
Two neutral layers (paper, wash) plus ink; one accent, signal red.
State is a word plus a fixed-position mark; cell height and column width never depend on content.
One inverted opaque ink plate per screen for the main action.

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Red marks the thing the user is acting on or must notice: their own booking, the live selection, a slot that changed, an error. It is never decoration, never a heading colour, never a fill on chrome.

rules.name: The Selection Exception Rule
rules.body: Seleccionada's red outline is the one deliberate exception beside Tuya and the changed-slot hold: the selection is the live state the user is acting on. It earns red by that role and sets no precedent for other red outlines.

rules.name: The Colour-Reinforces Rule
rules.body: A state must be fully legible in greyscale from its word and mark. Colour is added second.

rules.name: The Few Sizes Rule
rules.body: The ramp is 0.75, 0.8125, 0.9375, 1.0625, 1.25, 1.75, 2.5rem. A new surface picks from it; it does not add a size.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Hours, dates and counts are set tabular; the hour is large and its minutes quiet.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats off the page. A new element is separated by a rule or a layer change, not by a shadow, blur or lift.

dos: Do give every state a word plus a fixed-position mark, and let colour only reinforce it.
Do keep cell height (3.875rem) and column width (5.75rem) independent of content.
Do use ink and the paper/wash layers for structure; separate with 1px `rule` hairlines or 1.5px ink rules.
Do keep one inverted plate for the primary action per screen.
Do use signal red only for Tuya, the selection, the changed-slot hold and errors.
Do keep controls at least 2.75rem tall and use the 3px ink focus outline.
donts: Don't add rounded corners, cards, drop shadows, blur or gradient fills.
Don't introduce a second accent or use red as chrome, heading colour or decoration.
Don't convey state by colour alone, or hide a state word.
Don't make the grid reflow when a cell is selected or a name is added.
Don't add typefaces or sizes outside the ramp above.
